caption:
This past spring, the US military faced a critical situation when a false intelligence report indicated a Chinese ship was transporting nuclear weapon components. The report, generated with AI assistance, was later found to be entirely inaccurate and nearly led to armed conflict. The incident highlights the dangers of relying on AI for military intelligence. 🚨🤖

Should AI be used in military operations?

Sources: CNN
